lines.text: CWP works in environments where pollution can have serious consequences, particularly on water-sector projects, and near rivers, drains, and watercourses.
Fuel, oils, chemicals, and other hazardous substances must be stored and handled correctly.
Spill kits must be available where required, and any spill must be reported immediately.
Never wash concrete, cement slurry, chemicals, or contaminated water into drains, or onto unprotected ground.
Waste must be segregated, and disposed of through approved arrangements.
Noise, dust, mud on roads, and unnecessary disturbance must be controlled.
Environmental incidents and near misses are to be reported in the same way as safety incidents.
Store it right. Keep it out of the water. Report every spill.
